scope: Finite local Kubernetes recovery checks for the selected adapter observation streams and retained simulated inspections. No universal conformance or real-plant safety claim.
guarantees: same command identity and deadline after consumer restart
source event retention through consumer/source/broker restart
bounded native acknowledgement and simulated counter reconciliation
assumptions: one active authority per stateful role
trusted native device and broker boundary
all clock-dependent checks require recorded shared local clock or separate measured bounds
finite run is shorter than event and command retention; bottle IDs do not wrap within the capture
